No wall-time acceptance threshold; compare deterministic query counts and snapshot output equality.

initial_run.failure: test_performance_fenced_fill_transaction expected the old exact budget of 12 SQL statements, observed 11

full_pg.correction: Update the exact indexed/unindexed statement budget to 11; recorder runtime unchanged after full collection.
full_pg.note: 342 full-run passes plus the corrected formerly failing case. The focused 11-case group overlaps 10 prior passes; not a single 343-pass run.

p3_notes: Actual ServiceHost.mm_runtime_ready, controller reference/exposure math, and fee composition; mocked cached connector/account/book reads and a static 0.1% maker fee.

Five repetitions of 100 healthy calls; six working levels per controller; extra cProfile 100-call series. Volatility candles, bootstrap and drawdown policies disabled; this does not model all production guard work.

One reference/exposure/compose and six fee reads per controller per invocation. Measured under concurrent local regression startup; timings include mocks and local scheduling, not network or engine latency.
No additional cache introduced: scope is too small to justify stale price/account/fee risks or explain seconds-long probes.
